the design of a low-complexity MIMO-OFD detection algorithm that achieves the performance of the conventional QDR-M with only 30% of its computational requirements.
the design of a low-complexity MIMO detector that is capable of achieving a near-optimum performance.
the development of a new low-complexity algorithm capable of achieving the performance of the conventional QRM-M.

the proposed algorithm is the most suitable algorithm for MIMO-OFDMA systems in the context of high complexity and low complexity trade-off.

ULBC QRD- M is a very promising low complexity algorithm for practical implementation of the MIMO-OFD systems.

we introduce a new algorithm with a complexity that can be adjusted according to the system performance requirements.

the proposed ULBC QRD algorithm achieves a significant reduction in the computational complexity of the conventional QRM-M algorithm while preserving the performance.
